description: This file defines the MerchantStoreDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface and provides methods for retrieving MerchantStore and Product objects related to merchant stores.

classes.name: MerchantStoreDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to MerchantStore entities, extending generic DAO functionalities and adding specific methods.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of Product objects associated with a given MerchantStore, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore by its integer ID.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore by its code string, may throw a ServiceException.
